root_cause.log_evidence: could not write to file pg_wal/xlogtemp.*: No space left on device
root_cause.startup_effect: PostgreSQL recovery repeatedly exits because WAL temp files cannot be written.
downstream_effects: PostgREST cannot connect to PostgreSQL and emits PGRST000/PGRST002.
direct SQL control-plane access is unavailable.
Page Change end-to-end canary cannot reach Capture/bootstrap.

platform_metadata.truth_boundary: Management-plane health label conflicts with database/postgrest runtime evidence; runtime evidence governs this incident.

recovery_gate: Restore enough database disk headroom for PostgreSQL to complete recovery and accept connections.
Re-run direct SQL health checks and Page Change Capture bootstrap.
Re-run the existing Page Change Worker Pool canary.
Do not promote Control Room V11 until the real worker post-claim private-packet gate and human review also pass.
remediation_boundary: The database cannot be cleaned with SQL while it cannot finish startup. Recovery requires a platform-level storage action or provider intervention before ordinary database maintenance is possible.
